_source: results/hpc_vicuna_autodan/resolved_config.yaml, results/hpc_vicuna/resolved_config.yaml, results/*/calibration.json, Slurm sacct. All values copied from artifacts now tracked in this repository; none are recalled from memory.

C1_attack_configuration._note: Both adversaries share the target-side settings. The GCG block below is from the hpc_vicuna run; the fluent block from hpc_vicuna_autodan. Note that resolved_config.yaml carries both parameter families in every run because they share a config schema, but only the block matching attack.adaptive.method is live.

shared.in_loop_objective: target logprob of the affirmative prefix, first 12 tokens (target_prefix_tokens: 12) - CONFIRMED, and the gold judge is never reachable from the attack loop (enforced by tests/test_no_judge_in_loop.py)

fluent_autodan_style.restarts: none; restart_after_stall is a GCG-path parameter and is inert here
fluent_autodan_style.stopping_criterion: fixed generation budget (30); no early stop on the GA path

gcg.stopping_criterion: loss below early_stop_loss (0.4) or steps exhausted (60)

target_decoding._note: greedy decoding; verified in dcorr/target.py generate()

C2_compute.gpu_type: NVIDIA H100 (nodes report gpu:h100:2); every dcorr job allocated gres/gpu=1, so one H100 per job
C2_compute._attribution_caveat: Job names do not map cleanly onto the five reported runs, and several jobs are TIMEOUT/FAILED/CANCELLED and therefore wasted compute rather than reported results. The total is exact; any per-run split below the job level would be a guess and is not offered.

C3_defense_operating_points._calibration: target_fpr 0.01 on the n=100 benign set. Only the four score-thresholded defenses are calibrated; the other three have no scalar threshold.
C3_defense_operating_points._in_sample_warning: The realised FPR of 0.01 on n=100 is ONE benign prompt. This is the M4 identifiability concern and the figure should be read as such.

smoothllm.threshold: n/a - majority vote over q perturbations

promptguard._note: present in stack.order but disabled in every reported run; it is NOT one of the seven

probe_training_pool._from: results/hpc_llama2_autodan/probe_train_report.json (replication; the primary run's report was not retained)

C4_judge_parse_failures._definition: parse_ok is false only for responses actually sent to the judge; blocked inputs are never judged, so both denominators below are meaningful.
C4_judge_parse_failures._manuscript_check: The manuscript's '2.4% (66 of 2700)' is CORRECT. An earlier note in this repository claimed otherwise; it was based on a stale 2400-row copy of gold.jsonl pulled before the 300 assembled-stack rows were judged. That copy was a strict subset with zero differing verdicts, so no other reported number was affected.
